name: SUDS
definition: A 4D representation for large-scale dynamic urban scenes that factorizes the scene into three separate hash table data structures to efficiently encode static, dynamic, and far-field radiance fields, using unlabeled target signals (RGB, sparse LiDAR, 2D descriptors, 2D optical flow) for supervision.
summary: SUDS is a 4D radiance field for large-scale dynamic urban scenes that distinguishes itself by factorizing the scene into static, dynamic, and far-field branches using unlabeled supervision.
